unit.why: A brief anecdote: followers from Homel walk on foot to R. Nahum of Chernobyl, and he greets them with a verse and its interpretation. It is quoted as part of a treatise section on going to one's rebbe.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a homiletic section 'מענין הליכה לרבו' that continues into the next division

stories.start_quote: ונקדים מה ששמעתי בשם הק׳ ר׳ נחום
stories.summary_en: Hasidim from Homel came on foot to R. Nahum of Chernobyl, who greeted them with 'How beautiful are your steps in sandals,' explaining that the verse once referred to Temple pilgrims and now refers to those who wear out their feet for a mitzvah.
